brief:
The Quincy Institute said Trump's Iran strategy contains contradictions and gaps, according to an analysis of his stated positions on sanctions, nuclear talks, and regional deterrence. The think tank did not detail how the incoming administration plans to reconcile competing objectives.

The institute also raised questions about potential strains between the United States and Israel under a Trump administration, though specifics on policy differences were not outlined.
title: Quincy Institute questions Trump's Iran policy coherence
